literal.prompt: Какая застёжка сводит два ряда металлических или пластиковых зубцов с помощью бегунка?

literalGroups.primaryGround: Merriam-Webster defines a zipper as two rows of metal or plastic teeth with a sliding piece that draws them together; the other selected devices use a buttonhole, a ball/socket, or a hook/bar mechanism, so only zipper matches the described moving slider and tooth rows.

literalGroups.literal: Молния закрывает отверстие, когда бегунок сводит её зубцы вместе. Зубцы закреплены на отдельных лентах; пуговица проходит через петлю, кнопка-защёлка сцепляет шарик с гнездом, а крючок цепляется за дужку.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW gives the zipper tooth/slider mechanism (L38), button passage through a buttonhole or loop (L48, L139-L143), snap fastener ball/socket (L34), and hook-and-eye catch (L34), matching each contrast.

literalGroups.primaryGround: MW defines a clothing button as a small knob or disk used as a fastener by passing through a buttonhole or loop.

literalGroups.literal: В такой застёжке шарик одной части входит в гнездо другой.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW defines a snap fastener as a ball and socket attached to opposed parts and used to hold meeting garment edges together.

literalGroups.literal: Металлический крючок цепляется за планку или входит в петлю.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW defines hook and eye as a two-part device with a metal hook catching over a bar or into a loop.

literalGroups.literal: Её зубцы расположены на двух отдельных полосах ленты.
literalGroups.primaryGround: MW specifies that the two zipper tooth rows sit on strips of tape, a construction detail not stated in the prompt or key.

absoluteDifficulty.ground: The prompt asks for recognition of a specific apparel-fastener construction: a sliding part draws two rows of teeth together. A player familiar with clothing fasteners is likely to recognize the mechanism; an unfamiliar player can narrow or guess among four plausible closure types. The statement does not rely on an obviously impossible distractor or on a second correct key.
